question: Which gallery can be found within 20 kilometers while moving northeast from Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC, Bayonne, NJ?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.122011 40.662412)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.122011 40.662412)',4326)::geography, 20000)
AND tourism = 'gallery'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5;
